packageRules.description: Pin workflow job container and service images to immutable digests

Exempt pin/digest updates from the release-age cooldown. GitHub Actions digest refreshes carry no release timestamp, so under minimumReleaseAge + strict internal checks they would sit pending forever and pinned SHAs would stop refreshing. The cooldown still applies to version (minor/patch/major) updates.
Automerge non-major GitHub Actions updates once required checks pass
Require manual review for actions the PR build never exercises (they only run in the bundle/release-only jobs, so a green PR build does not validate them)
Hold major updates for manual review via the Dependency Dashboard
